note: USACE campground on a wooded peninsula of Lake Red Rock, Iowa's largest lake, 10 minutes from Pella and 15 from Knoxville; shaded gravel pads among hardwoods. Sites 69, 70 and 76 look out to the lake through the trees. Whitebreast Beach and a boat ramp nearby. --Claude
summary: Hookups electric 50, sites 132, facilities (showers, drinking water, dump) confirmed from rec.gov; flush/pit toilets and max rig 65 ft added; booking reservation-only (fcfs never), 14-night max and url added. Fees $20-24 unchanged (2026 rate table). Season left as stored (rec.gov states none). Note cleaned. Waterfront lead up to lakeview (official photos of 69, 70, 76).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (not waterfront -> lakeview): official rec.gov site photos of 069, 070 and 076 show the open lake through the trees (AWH 2026-11-01: a filtered view from even a few RV sites in official photos earns *view). No site is on-water: imagery puts every loop inside the peninsula's woods, the nearest pads (68-70 and 59-64) ~110-120 m from the shore through continuous canopy, and no site carries a shoreline attribute.
PHONE: entry has none. rec.gov gives the fee booth (641) 842-2969 ('For local information') and (641) 828-7522 for general information - suggest 641-842-2969 (apply.py does not write phone).

SEASON: no statement on rec.gov; the Peak Season rate dates (2026-04-23 to 2026-10-04) are a rate season, not stated as the campground season. Stored derived year_round false left alone. The 2027 calendar is all 'Closed' (season not released), 2026-11/12 'Not Available'.
FIT: no problem - every listed site allows RV/Tent/Trailer with Max Vehicle Length 24 ft or more (most 44-55 ft).
